feed_summary: SBOM pioneer Allan Friedman joined the SecurityWeek Podcast to discuss why knowing what is inside software is only the beginning, how AI is complicating software supply chain visibility, and what organizations should be doing with SBOM data once they have it. The post Software Transparency Is Changing: Allan Friedman on SBOM, AI BOMs and What Comes Next appeared first on SecurityWeek .
title: Software Transparency Is Changing: Allan Friedman on SBOM, AI BOMs and What Comes Next
